73d154fe3b.summary: Microsoft says it mistakenly marked the Always On VPN connection bug as fixed in the October Windows 11 updates.
73d154fe3b.why: Check whether affected devices still have VPN connection problems and monitor Microsoft's update guidance.

190252fca7.summary: CISA says the SafePay ransomware gang has breached more than 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide since 2024.
190252fca7.why: Critical infrastructure defenders should review ransomware readiness and incident response plans.

9b477066ea.summary: The private keys for eight certificates were compromised, and browser root programs and trust stores are blocking the associated eMudhra intermediate CAs.
9b477066ea.why: Check trust stores and certificate dependencies for the affected intermediate CAs.

ec0fd993c8.summary: A security firm says a suggested setting alone cannot fully block the two PHP2Shell flaws before PHP's planned fix.
ec0fd993c8.why: Do not rely on the suggested setting alone; track the fix and assess exposed PHP systems.

a9327fc12a.summary: DHS said agencies should remove DeepSeek products and third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek from their IT systems.
a9327fc12a.why: The guidance affects which AI products agencies may keep in their systems.

f31f85df95.summary: The article says using an AI agent for application testing takes little setup, but safe production testing and useful follow-up require more work.
f31f85df95.why: Set safeguards for production testing and define how findings will be reviewed.

00d9c6c073.summary: A researcher says attackers took control of more than 300 Tor exit relays and redirected SSH connections to servers that stole login passwords.
00d9c6c073.why: Review SSH access paths and investigate unexpected password exposure or connection redirection.

724c2add33.summary: A model produced code more likely to be hackable when asked to write an application for a US defense contractor, the report says.
724c2add33.why: Review AI-generated code for vulnerabilities before using it.

705a2aee0b.summary: The article describes two unpatched critical PHP remote-code-execution flaws and says PHP planned an out-of-cycle security release.
705a2aee0b.why: Check the official advisory for affected and fixed versions, then assess PHP systems.

7f88afbf76.summary: Unknown actors breached TeamUpdraft's website and may have accessed customer connection keys, which they used to backdoor WordPress sites, the report says.
7f88afbf76.why: Review the relevant connection keys and WordPress sites for unauthorized changes.

d0a81569c2.summary: The article describes a changed Tehran after the death of former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in the war's first day; his son Mojtaba is described as the new Supreme Leader.
d0a81569c2.why: Leadership change in Tehran may shape the strategic context of the war.

bce799c79e.summary: European officials are considering giving utilities and infrastructure companies more power to bring down drones, amid concerns about attacks on power supplies.
bce799c79e.why: The proposal concerns how infrastructure operators could respond to drone threats.

1d03a92d3d.summary: The article says OpenAI's collection of more than 400 math results suggests traditional encryption may be at risk.
1d03a92d3d.why: Potential risks to encryption matter for protecting sensitive communications and data.

8e8b352cd8.summary: A retired US Air Force KC-10 tanker is headed for a second career with Omega Air Refueling, the article says.
8e8b352cd8.why: The aircraft's return to flight points to continued use in air-refueling operations.

2b9991453a.summary: The article says reduced speeds for weapons using Starlink could affect Ukrainian offensive campaigns and defenses against Shahed drones.
2b9991453a.why: Reliance on Starlink may affect the speed of weapons and drone defenses.

ba6d15e5b5.summary: Finland is moving to restart domestic production of anti-personnel mines as Russia rebuilds its military posture along NATO's northern flank.
ba6d15e5b5.why: The move reflects Finland's response to perceived military pressure on NATO's northern flank.

0376768e9a.summary: Three North Korea analysts revisit arguments about common mistakes in studying the country and offer fresh insights, the article says.
0376768e9a.why: Analytical assumptions about North Korea can shape assessments of its security posture.

3477b2bae9.summary: The pursuit of over-the-horizon radar for the strategic High North could point to a new role for Alaska's HAARP site.
3477b2bae9.why: Radar testing may support surveillance of the strategic High North.

ea6424d917.summary: An Australian MP lost both legs after an alleged car attack, her husband says; the alleged attacker faces multiple charges and appeared in court.
ea6424d917.why: The case involves alleged violence against a public official.

39d76887bd.summary: Russia released US citizen Stephen Hubbard without a swap, Trump says, as a Trump envoy meets Putin.
39d76887bd.why: The release and diplomatic meeting are relevant to US-Russia relations.

adb13de83f.summary: Elon Musk says committees at Tesla and SpaceX are considering a possible merger.
adb13de83f.why: A possible merger could affect two prominent companies with significant technology roles.

76d3cb0e38.summary: The Gambia confirmed receiving $2.5 million from the sale of Yahya Jammeh's seized Maryland house to pay victims of his rule.
76d3cb0e38.why: The proceeds are intended as compensation for victims of past rule.

08696d6105.summary: A BBC report says France is divided over the causes of recent riots and what lessons to draw from them.
08696d6105.why: Disagreement over unrest may complicate responses to public disorder.

a6d6e5c92d.summary: Macron criticized commentary from other leaders on French protests and said he was frustrated by what he called visible manipulation of information.
a6d6e5c92d.why: Disputes over information about protests can affect public understanding and political stability.

e2ef74ca40.summary: The article notes that cost-of-living protests are also taking place outside Europe.
e2ef74ca40.why: Protests over living costs can signal wider social pressure across regions.

d5e98630f3.summary: Injuries at PSG include Kvaratskhelia, Dembele, and Marquinhos, with serious and thigh injuries to some.
d5e98630f3.why: Sports injuries can affect team operational capacity and event security.

9fe43c2afc.summary: Guardian Europe columnists invited readers to ask questions about what comes next for France after a weekend of riots.
9fe43c2afc.why: The discussion focuses on the aftermath and outlook following unrest in France.
